reason: The AWS Documentation MCP server (src/aws-documentation-mcp-server) runs on CPU over stdio and needs no AWS credentials, only public internet access to docs.aws.amazon.com.
demo: README -> src/aws-documentation-mcp-server (AWS Documentation MCP Server): install and start the stdio server, then call its read_documentation and search_documentation tools
goal: Install the awslabs.aws-documentation-mcp-server package from /work/mcp/src/aws-documentation-mcp-server (Python >=3.10, for example with uv or pip) into the environment that /work/env.sh activates. The `awslabs.aws-documentation-mcp-server` command, or `python -m awslabs.aws_documentation_mcp_server.server`, must start the stdio MCP server. Through an MCP client, the tools list must include read_documentation and search_documentation; read_documentation on https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/welcome.html must return the page content as markdown, and search_documentation must return AWS documentation results for a query.
check: The hidden test starts the installed server over stdio with an MCP client, lists the tools, reads a Lambda docs page and checks that substantial Lambda markdown comes back, and runs a documentation search and checks it returns docs.aws.amazon.com results.

revision.by: fairness review (every maintained-set exam re-checked against the source)
issues: Too lenient: `'lambda' in t.lower()` is always true, because read_documentation prefixes its output with 'AWS Documentation from <url>:' and the URL contains 'lambda'. isError is never checked; only the >500-char length guards against an error page.
search_documentation, a headline README feature that needs no credentials, is only checked for presence in the tool list and never called.

v2 checks isError, counts 'lambda' in the page body after the header line, and calls search_documentation, asserting docs.aws.amazon.com result URLs and no error result. Goal and check updated to mention search.
evidence: server_utils.py fetch_markdown (raises DocumentationToolError at ~204/232) — a fetch failure becomes an MCP isError result
server_aws.py:381-402 search_documentation -> SearchResponse; :498-515 failures become one SearchResult with url='' and title 'Error searching AWS docs...'
src/aws-documentation-mcp-server/README.md:9-10 — Read Documentation and Search Documentation are the first two features; pyproject.toml:38-39 console script
